text: Composer Scratchpad 是面向 DSH Web 和桌面端的 composer 草稿面板插件。它在输入框工具栏注册一个铅笔入口，打开独立文本框供用户暂存尚未决定发送的内容；在框内按 Enter 只换行，不会提交到主输入框。草稿、面板尺寸和提示状态保存于浏览器 localStorage，并由所有会话共用。用户可拖动调整面板大小、双击恢复默认尺寸，也可用 Escape 或点击面板外关闭。适合需要在 DSH 中临时整理想法、避免误发半成品的用户；无需 API 密钥或外部服务。

Composer Scratchpad adds a draft panel to the DSH composer. Click the pencil to write; Enter adds a line break without sending. Drafts stay in localStorage and are shared across sessions. Drag to resize, double-click to reset, or press Escape to close. No key or external service is needed.
我想先在 DSH 里记下还没想好要不要发送的话。
能不能在对话输入框旁边留一份跨会话共享的草稿？
I need a place to jot down a thought in DSH without accidentally sending it.
Composer Scratchpad 的「暂存草稿」功能：点击 composer 工具栏的铅笔按钮打开文本框，输入内容会保存在浏览器 localStorage，供不同会话共享；回车只换行，不会发送。
Composer Scratchpad 的「调整草稿面板」功能：拖动右下角把手改变面板宽高，双击把手恢复默认尺寸；面板开着时会随窗口尺寸和滚动重新定位。

dsh-composer-scratchpad README · dsh-composer-scratchpad：[English](README.en.md) | 中文

**输入框边上的一个草稿格。** 点工具栏那支铅笔，弹出一个纯净文本框：先把灵感写进去，
回车只换行，**永远不会发出去**。想好了再自己挪进输入框。

dsh-composer-scratchpad README · 它解决什么：你想写东西，但还没想好要不要发给模型。直接敲进输入框，一行回车就把半成品发出去了；
写进别的笔记应用，再切回来复制，上下文已经凉了。

这个插件在 **composer 工具栏**里加一个入口，内容仅存本机 `localStorage`，**所有会话共用同一份**，
切会话、切项目、刷新、重启都不丢。

dsh-composer-scratchpad README · 和笔记插件的区别：生态里已经有很完整的笔记插件（比如 `dsh-client-ui-notes`：文件树、标签页、Markdown 预览）。
那个解决的是「管理一堆文件」。

这个只解决一件事：**你还没决定发不发的那一句话**。所以它故意没有文件夹、没有标签、没有多页，
也故意没有发送按钮。

dsh-composer-scratchpad README · 运行环境：| 项 | 要求 |
| --- | --- |
| 宿主 | DSH Web 端（`dsh web`）或桌面端；桌面端跑的仍是 `profiles/web` 这一套 |

| 挂载点 | 客户端插槽 `conversation.input.right`，由 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conversation` 提供 |
| 浏览器 | 任何支持 `localStorage` 的浏览器；桌面端内嵌 WebView 同样可用 |
| Node | `>= 18`，只用于 `npm test`；插件本身运行不需要 Node |
| 网络 | 不需要。零依赖、无构建步骤、不发起任何请求 |

dsh-composer-scratchpad README · 运行环境：1. 重启内核——客户端模块清单在启动期生成，热装不会自动进清单；
2. `Ctrl+Shift+R` 硬刷新——客户端 bundle 带 `cache-control: immutable`，普通刷新拉不到新的；
3. `dsh plugin list --profile web` 确认插件真的进了 `bundles`；
4. 都没有就核对宿主版本，`conversation.input.right` 在这个版本里是否还存在。

面板配色只按深色主题写过（见下方「已知边界」），浅色主题下会难看——那是外观问题，不是装错了。

dsh-composer-scratchpad README · 命令行：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:br0caz/dsh-composer-scratchpad
```

dsh-composer-scratchpad README · 走 npm（发布之后）：包还没发到 npm，上面两条走的是 GitHub 源。等 `dsh-composer-scratchpad` 上架 npm 之后，
才可以只写包名：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-composer-scratchpad
```

装完重启内核（客户端模块清单在启动期生成）。**从源码或本地路径装时**，改完 `client.js`
还要 `Ctrl+Shift+R` 硬刷新一次——客户端 bundle 带 `cache-control: immutable`，
普通刷新不会重新拉。

dsh-composer-scratchpad README · 用法：| 操作 | 结果 |
| --- | --- |
| 点铅笔图标 | 打开 / 收起面板 |
| `Esc` 或点面板外 | 收起 |
| `Enter` | **只换行**（键盘事件在面板内就地截断，不进主编辑器的提交链路） |
| 拖动右下角把手 | 左拖变宽、上拖变高（面板贴着工具栏往上弹） |
| 双击把手 | 回到默认 380×220 |
| 图标右上角小点 | 表示里面还有内容 |

第一次打开时会浮出一句「可拖动调整大小」，2.4 秒淡出。判据是**教到会为止**：
拖过一次就永不再提；没拖过最多提 3 次。

dsh-composer-scratchpad README · 数据在哪：| 键 | 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| `dsh-composer-scratchpad` 前缀（历史键名 `dsh-memo-pad:*`） | 正文、面板尺寸、提示计数 |

只写本机 `localStorage`，不联网、不进会话、不上传。换浏览器或清站点数据会丢；
需要跨设备请用浏览器账号同步或自行导出。

dsh-composer-scratchpad README · 实现：没有构建步骤，没有依赖：

- `client.js` —— 全部逻辑与 UI，手写 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })`，
  React 从宿主模块表 `require` 得到，不打包、不带 React 副本；
- 挂载点是客户端插槽 `conversation.input.right`（composer 工具栏、模型选择器左边）。
  不占用 `conversation.input.activity`——那个是单例槽，通常被语音输入插件占了；
- `index.js` —— 宿主半边，故意为空；
- `cordis.patch.yml` —— 让插件管理器一键挂载；
- `tests/smoke.cjs` —— 迷你 React + 迷你 DOM 的 7 项自测，`npm test` 即可跑，不需要浏览器。

dsh-composer-scratchpad README · 已知边界：- 面板配色按深色主题写死（`#2a2b2f`）；
- 只有一个文本框、单份内容（这是设计，不是没做完）；
- 内容不进工作区文件，AI 读不到（同样是有意的：这是你的草稿，不是给模型的上下文）。

dsh-composer-scratchpad README · dsh-composer-scratchpad：English | [中文](README.md)

**A scratchpad pinned to the composer.** Click the pencil in the tool row and a plain
textarea opens: park the idea first, press Enter and it only breaks the line — it can
never be sent by accident. Move it into the input when you actually mean it.

dsh-composer-scratchpad README · What it is for：You have something to write but you have not decided whether to send it. Typing it
straight into the composer means one Enter publishes a half-finished thought; writing it
in a separate notes app means a context switch and a copy-paste later.

This plugin adds one entry to the **composer tool row**. The text lives only in your
browser's `localStorage`, **shared by every session** — switching sessions, switching
workspaces, reloading or restarting does not lose it.

dsh-composer-scratchpad README · How it differs from a notes plugin：The ecosystem already has full notes plugins (file trees, tabs, Markdown preview) that
manage a folder of documents. This one does exactly one thing: **the sentence you have
not decided to send yet**. So it deliberately has no folders, no tags, no pages, and no
send button.
section: How it differs from a notes plugin

dsh-composer-scratchpad README · Requirements：| Item | Requirement |
| --- | --- |
| Host | DSH web (`dsh web`) or the desktop app; the desktop app runs the same `profiles/web` set |
| DSH version | `>= 0.2.0` (see `engines.dsh`). Verified on `0.2.1-rc.2`; earlier versions are untested |
| Mount point | the client slot `conversation.input.right`, provided by `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conversation` |
| Browser | any browser with `localStorage`; the embedded WebView of the desktop app works too |
| Node | `>= 18`, only for `npm test`; running the plugin needs none |
| Network | none. No dependencies, no build step, no requests |

dsh-composer-scratchpad README · Requirements：The panel colours are written for the dark theme only (see "Known limits"); on a light
theme it looks wrong, which is cosmetic and not a bad install.

dsh-composer-scratchpad README · Install：The package is not on npm yet, so both ways below install from the GitHub source.

From the **Plugins** panel in the sidebar, add:

```
github:br0caz/dsh-composer-scratchpad
```

Or from a terminal:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:br0caz/dsh-composer-scratchpad
```

dsh-composer-scratchpad README · From npm (once published)：After `dsh-composer-scratchpad` is published to npm, the bare package name works:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-composer-scratchpad
```

Restart the kernel afterwards — the client module manifest is produced at boot. When you
install from a source or local path and then edit `client.js`, also press
`Ctrl+Shift+R`: the client bundle is served with `cache-control: immutable`, so an
ordinary reload will not fetch it again.

dsh-composer-scratchpad README · Usage：| Action | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Click the pencil | Open / close the panel |
| `Esc` or click outside | Close |
| `Enter` | **Line break only** — the key event is stopped inside the panel, so it never reaches the composer's submit path |
| Drag the corner grip | Drag left to widen, up to grow taller (the panel opens upward from the tool row) |
| Double-click the grip | Back to the default 380×220 |
| Dot on the icon | There is text inside |

dsh-composer-scratchpad README · Usage：The first time the panel opens, a small line reading “可拖动调整大小” (drag to resize)
fades out after 2.4 s. It is shown **until you actually resize**: once you have dragged it
stops forever; if you never drag, it appears at most three times.

dsh-composer-scratchpad README · Where the data lives：| Keys | Content |
| --- | --- |
| `dsh-composer-scratchpad:*` (legacy `dsh-memo-pad:*`) | text, panel size, hint counter |

Written to `localStorage` only. No network calls, nothing is added to the conversation,
nothing is uploaded. Clearing site data loses it; use browser sync or export it yourself
if you need it elsewhere.
